first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and two inherited memories indicate that simplification improves completion, time-to-value, and durable first-week activation. This is currently the strongest direct response to both deteriorating metrics. Verify promotional-pricing evidence as the main alternative given competitor pressure, with particular attention to qualified revenue, retention, and margin rather than acquisition lift alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The confirmed prior test improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing both current declines while supporting sustainable value. SMB signup simplification also lifted activation and qualified revenue, though its slight retention decline and limited segment replication warrant monitoring retention and qualified revenue guardrails. Do not prioritize promotional pricing: despite acquisition and qualified-revenue lift, the verified discounted cohort had 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive first renewal.
